summary.revenue: Gross bookings up 18% year-over-year. Trips up 18% year-over-year. Specific revenue figure not disclosed.
summary.guidance: Q3 2025: 'another quarter of high teens gross bookings growth and low to mid-30s EBITDA growth.' New $20 billion share repurchase authorization announced.
key_opportunities: Cross-platform strategy: fewer than 1 in 5 consumers are active across both Mobility and Delivery, with cross-platform users having 35% higher retention, 3x gross bookings and profits.
Autonomous vehicle partnerships: expanded with Waymo, WeRide, Baidu, Lucid, Nuro, Wayve, and others; Waymo vehicles busier than 99% of human drivers in completed trips per day.
Lower-cost products (Moto, premium, reserve) driving audience growth; Moto over $1.5B gross bookings growing 40%, premium over $10B growing 35%, reserve growing 60%.
Uber One membership: 36 million members, growing 60%, with new surge savings product for Mobility.
Externalizing tech capabilities: advertising business, data collection for AV, Uber AI solutions for data labeling and translation.

evidence.claim: Gross bookings and trips both grew 18% year-over-year.
evidence.quote: This powered robust growth in trips and gross bookings, both up 18%.

evidence.claim: Q2 achieved all-time highs in audience, frequency, adjusted EBITDA, GAAP operating income, and free cash flow.
evidence.quote: Q2 was another quarter of new records for Uber as we achieved all-time highs in both audience and frequency. This powered robust growth in trips and gross bookings, both up 18%. We also reached new highs for adjusted EBITDA, GAAP operating income and free cash flow.

evidence.claim: Management guides for Q3 high teens gross bookings growth and low to mid-30s EBITDA growth.
evidence.quote: We're expecting more of the same strong performance in Q3 with another quarter of high teens gross bookings growth and low to mid-30s EBITDA growth.

evidence.claim: New $20 billion share repurchase authorization announced.
evidence.quote: That's why today, we announced a new $20 billion share repurchase authorization as part of our sustained focus on value creation for our shareholders.

evidence.claim: Cross-platform users have 35% higher retention and generate 3x gross bookings and profits.
evidence.quote: The great news is that the – those who kind of use both sides, both mobility and delivery, their retention rates are higher, they are 35% higher than single-business consumers. They generate 3 times the gross bookings and profits than single-business consumers as well.

evidence.claim: Waymo vehicles are busier than 99% of human drivers in completed trips per day.
evidence.quote: And in both cases, the average Waymo is busier than 99% of our drivers in terms of completed trips per day.

evidence.claim: Moto gross bookings over $1.5B growing 40%, premium over $10B growing 35%, reserve growing 60%.
evidence.quote: So for example, Moto, which are two-wheelers that are coming in a bunch of our developing markets now, it is over kind of $1.5 billion in gross bookings, growing 40%. A bunch of them on the premium side as well, our premium business is now over $10 billion, growing 35% and our reserve business continues to grow 60%.

evidence.claim: Uber One has 36 million members, growing 60%.
evidence.quote: Uber One, we've been very, very happy about growing 60%, 36 million members.
Simply put, we've never been more excited about what Uber is delivering today or the many opportunities ahead.
